_doc: Shared combat constants. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-combat.md. Key suffixes give units: S = seconds, M = metres, Mps = metres per second, Deg = degrees, Ticks = ticks. Unsuffixed fractions are decimals (0.04 = 4%) and convert to basis points; points (HP, focus, armor, ward, composure) are integers. Loaders convert once: metres x100 -> cm for events and displays (sim positions and per-tick movement are integer mm, x1000, per D-E), seconds x20 -> ticks, fractions x10000 -> bp; every value converts exactly.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (combat designer). Values are PROPOSED · TUNABLE unless the spec says REQUIRED.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Raw force. Drives Power for heavy and melee classes and adds a little max HP.

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.description: Hand speed and footwork. Faster basic attacks and a chance to evade weapon blows.

attributes.name: Pace
attributes.description: Running speed. How fast a fighter closes, chases, kites and escapes.

attributes.name: Toughness
attributes.description: Durability. The main source of max HP and a little armor. Races modify it (durability tag).

attributes.name: Precision
attributes.description: Aim and timing. Critical-hit chance, and Power for archers and throwers.

attributes.name: Arcana
attributes.description: Command of spellcraft. Power for casters, arcane blades and hexers.

attributes.name: Spirit
attributes.description: Inner warmth that mends others. The main source of Support (healing and shields).

attributes.name: Willpower
attributes.description: Resistance to magic. Ward against arcane damage and shorter slows and debuffs.

attributes.name: Composure
attributes.description: Calm under pressure. Shorter stuns and roots, steadier reactions when hurt or when the captain falls.

attributes.name: Leadership
attributes.description: Command presence. The main input to captaincy; no effect on a fighter who is not captain.

attributes.name: Awareness
attributes.description: Reading the fight. Shorter reaction delay when the fighter changes what it is doing.

attributes.name: Discipline
attributes.description: Pacing and self-control. Faster focus regeneration, so more abilities per round.

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Staying power: how many rounds and matches a fighter can play before tiring. It acts only through Freshness (lifecycle); it has no effect during a fight.
usedFor: freshness drain per round played and recovery between weeks (lifecycle)

archetypes.name: Tank
archetypes.description: Front-liners who soak damage, protect allies and hold enemies in place.

archetypes.name: Melee DPS
archetypes.description: Close-quarters damage dealers who dive, duel and finish.

archetypes.name: Ranged DPS
archetypes.description: Damage from a distance; fragile if caught.

archetypes.name: Controller
archetypes.description: Slows, roots, stuns, silences and debuffs that shape where and how the fight happens.

archetypes.name: Healer
archetypes.description: Restore HP, shield allies and cleanse harmful effects.

derived._doc: d(x) = effective attribute - 10. Coefficients are per attribute point. Each formula truncates toward zero once, at its end.

combatModsDefaults._doc: Optional per-fighter hooks (race or future content). Neutral defaults. Races act mainly through attribute tendencies on lifecycle tags (Toughness carries the durability tag).

roundEnd._doc: Applied at the hard cap, and when both sides lose their last fighter on the same tick. First difference wins.

match._squadDoc: sys-match (M1.1): match squads and swaps. Owner rules: squad of 5 starters + 2 reserves; at most 2 swaps per match, between rounds only; a fighter swapped out cannot return in that match (owner ruling 2026-10-26).

swaps.between: rounds only (never before round 1, never after the deciding round)
swaps.decision: simultaneous and blind; applied home then away
swaps.injuryReplacement: forced; an unused reserve enters and uses a swap; with none left an emergency entrant enters without a swap
swaps.emergencyEntrant: best-fit fit roster fighter outside the match squad (same role family, then rating, then freshness, then fighter id); else a hired blade

captain._doc: sys-fight-captain. Adopts the lifecycle proposal (development.json captaincy.inFightProposal): reliability through composure, never raw damage. Grades come from development.json captaincy.grades by CQ; CQ arrives with the fight setup.

aura.scope: every fielded ally including the acting captain, while the acting captain is standing

rally.trigger: first ally other than the acting captain downed while the acting captain stands

down.handover: when Shaken ends: vice-captain if fielded and standing, else the standing ally with the highest CQ (ties: lower slot); acting CQ = CQ - development.json captaincy.actingCaptainCqPenalty

traitEffectAdapter._doc: How traits.json effects owned by combat enter the fight (sys-fight-traits). Each "combat" effect becomes one statMod per mod key with the mapped predicate. Trait-sourced mods are summed per stat and capped by derived.traitModCaps.

otherTypes.enemyComposureAura: aura on enemies within the named band: statMod composure = add
otherTypes.shakenImmune: multiplies negative composure from Shaken and from allyDown-conditioned mods by mult (0 = immune)
otherTypes.captainRally: if this fighter is acting captain, multiplies rally composure (truncated) and rally duration by mult

randomness._doc: All draws use core/rng (sfc32 + cyrb128). Round seed = deriveSeed(matchSeed, "round", n). Purpose streams are derived from the round seed by label so adding a roll type never shifts another.

streams.use: initial crit and evade accumulator phases: 2 draws at fight start
one draw per damage instance the unit deals
opening stagger (1 draw) and reaction jitter (1 draw per committed decision change)
final coin flip of the round-end tiebreak only

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.description: Cannot move, attack or use abilities. Interrupts casts and channels.

statuses.name: Asleep
statuses.description: As Stunned, but wakes at the end of any tick in which it took damage of at least 8% of its max HP.

statuses.name: Rooted
statuses.description: Cannot move or dash. Can still attack and cast. Ends mobile channels.

statuses.name: Silenced
statuses.description: Cannot use active abilities. Basic attacks still work. Interrupts casts and channels.

statuses.name: Taunted
statuses.description: Rules are suspended: must move to and basic-attack the taunter. The latest taunt wins.

statuses.name: Slowed
statuses.description: Move speed reduced. Only the strongest slow applies.

statuses.name: Sluggish
statuses.description: Attack speed reduced. Only the strongest applies.

statuses.name: Hasted
statuses.description: Move speed increased.

statuses.name: Frenzied
statuses.description: Attack speed increased.

statuses.name: Momentum
statuses.description: Attack speed increased per stack. Separate from Frenzied, so both apply.

statuses.name: Empowered
statuses.description: Deals more damage.

statuses.name: Weakened
statuses.description: Deals less damage.

statuses.name: Shaken
statuses.description: The acting captain fell: composure reduced for a few seconds (sys-fight-captain). Some traits reduce or ignore it.

statuses.name: Fortified
statuses.description: Takes less damage.

statuses.name: Vulnerable
statuses.description: Takes more damage.

statuses.name: Marked
statuses.description: A posted bounty: takes more damage from everyone. Separate from Vulnerable, so both apply.

statuses.name: Armored
statuses.description: Armor increased (flat).

statuses.name: Sundered
statuses.description: Armor reduced (flat, never below 0).

statuses.name: Warded
statuses.description: Ward increased (flat).

statuses.name: Unwarded
statuses.description: Ward reduced (flat, never below 0).

statuses.name: Festering
statuses.description: Receives less healing and smaller shields.

statuses.name: Barbed
statuses.description: Reflects part of the weapon damage taken from attackers in melee range.

statuses.name: Bloodthirsty
statuses.description: Heals for part of the damage it deals.

statuses.name: Evasive
statuses.description: Higher chance to evade weapon blows (total evade is capped at 75%).

statuses.name: Bleeding
statuses.description: Takes physical damage every tick interval.

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.description: Takes arcane damage every tick interval.

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.description: Takes arcane damage every tick interval; stacks.

statuses.name: Regenerating
statuses.description: Heals every tick interval.

statuses.name: Guarded
statuses.description: While the guardian stands within the guard radius, part of the damage taken is redirected to the guardian.

statuses.name: Riposting
statuses.description: Each evaded weapon blow from melee range triggers a counter-strike (magnitude = Power coefficient).

statuses.name: Deathwarded
statuses.description: The first time it would be downed, it stays at 1 HP and is healed instead; then the ward ends.

statuses.name: Anchored
statuses.description: Self-chosen stance: cannot move, immune to knockback and pull. Not crowd control.

statuses.name: Illuminated
statuses.description: Allies who damage this enemy heal for a share (magnitude) of the damage dealt.

statuses.name: Rallied
statuses.description: The captain's rally after an ally fell: composure increased, ally-down penalties suppressed.

freshness._doc: Per-fighter freshness 0-100 arrives in each round input (lifecycle owns drain per round played, recovery and labels). Severity s = clamp((thresholdBelow - F) / (thresholdBelow - fullPenaltyAtOrBelow), 0, 1) from the freshness at the start of that round; fixed for the whole round. Each penalty = penaltyAtFull x s x (1 - fatigueResist). KI-21 (O36): steeper, penaltyAtFull x1.375 of the M1.1 values and full at 25.
freshness.labelsFrom: levels.json freshness.labels (fresh >= 80, ready >= 60, tired >= 40, spent < 40); reports tag a fighter Tired or Spent with the penalty applied
